heading.title: Appearance of parties and consequence of non-appearance

article.title: Plaintiff may bring fresh suit or Court may restore suit to file.
article.content:
4Plaintiff may bring fresh suit or Court may restore suit to file.

Order 9, Rule 4
Where a suit is dismissed under rule 2 or rule 3, the plaintiff may (subject to the law of limitation) bring a fresh suit; or he may apply for an order to set the dismissal aside, and if he satisfies the Court that there was sufficient cause for 2[such failure as is referred to in rule 2], or for his non-appearance, as the case may be, the Court shall make an order setting aside the dismissal and shall appoint a day for proceeding with the suit.

2 Subs. by Act 104 of 1976 s. 59, for certain words (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
